asr.full_text: Contrary to what I thought and what many others thought The Note 8 Pro does indeed have support for Gcam. Some amazing developers have made it possible If you want to jump straight to the video, you can just skip But I would like to start with an apology to All those people who actually bought the note 8 instead of the note 8 pro because I said the note 8 has Gcam and the note 8 pro doesn't I shouldn't have blindly assumed it. I don't have excuses. I'm not gonna justify myself. I'm really, really sorry. The Note 8 is still the best value for your money. It's the best phone under 10,000 rupees and if you compare Note 8 GCAM and Note 8 Pro GCAM, Note 8 GCAM is better. It's mostly because the Note 8 Pro GCAM is not that stable yet but still, a mistake is a mistake. If some of you thought the Note 8 GCAM is better… it's mostly because the Note 8 Pro GCAM is not that stable yet. But still, a mistake is a mistake! If some of you thought the Note 8 Pro would get GCAM, then you would have waited, so it was a huge mistake on my side and I guarantee it won't happen again… haven't said that, lets get to the video Before I show you how to install and configure Gcam Let me introduce you to these amazing skins from capes India our sponsor for this video There are so many colors and textures available So there is something for everybody and everything is completely customizable. The newly launched brown leather is my favorite. Looks amazing. The quality is top notch as always. The cutouts are precise and perfect, and of course, they are available for a lot of other devices as well. So do check out Capes India. Link in the description. Use the promo code tjock, to get 10% discount. So first thing go to the description, click the download link, you will land on this page, download the gcam apk file and the configuration file, install the apk, open gcam, go to settings, scroll all the way to the bottom of the page, save settings, try type some randomm text randomm name, now the configuration file you just downloaded, copy it. Now go into internal storage, GCam, Configs Paste it here. Now go back to gcam, double tap on empty area near the button and select the file we just pasted. Done! Now an important note this Gcam port supports almost everything Main Camera, Ultra wide, Macro camera and Night Sight works on all three Cameras only the video mode doesn't work as of now so the support is great The fact that you can access all three rear cameras is amazing by itself. Most phones cannot do that, but the image quality itself is not the best right now they're so good. Don't get me wrong, but not as good as what you would normally expect from GCam. But the reason I'm still posting this video is because the developers are actively working on improving the performance. And once they come up with newer versions, the updated APKs will appear on this page automatically. So you can check this page once every few days, if there is a new version, download it, and download the configuration file as well, and follow the same instructions to install it. and before installing the new version, make sure you uninstall the old version Finally, the comparison G-cam images actually look really good in some cases it's been the better performer here the stock camera kind of overexposed everything and the colors are a bit messed up but G-cam gets it right Same here look at the road But the major problem arises when you have a close look at the images. A lot of these images that I got from my Gcam footage are kind of smudged up. They're not very crisp. The details are there, but they're very soft. It's not the usual Gcam behaviour, I'm sure of that. The stock camera gets the better images for the most part, sharper, cleaner, with better colours. Most of Gcam images have this pink tint, which kinda messes up the colors a bit. And everything I just said applies to ultra-white photos as well. GCam images come out really well. In some instances they are better, but in most instances, the stock camera images seem slightly better. They're ideally bright and sharp. GCam's low-light images face the same issue. The colors are a bit off. They are quite cool. Cool as in you can notice of bluish tone throughout the image. And yet the lack of sharpness can also be noticed here when you zoom in. Nightsight is amazing. Yes, the photos still run out soft. But look at the bigger picture. Pun intended. Overall it has much less noise. The trees are a little brighter they are visible to an extent and the colours are a bit more vibrant. Same here, it's soft and smudged but it retains more details than the stock camera image So here's a great example of where Gcam is heading in a few weeks. When it comes to selfies, the stock camera is the clear winner. Not just because Gcam is not at its best, But also because the stock camera has improved a lot. If you remember in my note 7 Pro videos I was cribbing about the front camera's HDR, which didn't really do much But this time around the selfie camera performance is really good. Great dynamic range colors and detail levels Sometimes it seems a little underexposed and GCam images look better but overall, I would definitely give this round to the stock camera. So yeah, GCam is not at it's best. But this is definitely a step in the right direction. the biggest headache is to get all the cameras to work on GCam and the developers have managed to do that already. And now it's just a matter of time before we start seeing better APKs and configurations. Do make sure to visit this download page, every once in awhile. I'll be posting updates on my twitter as well. So, once again, to those of you who wanted to get the Note8 Pro but got the Note8 because of me, I am so sorry. I totally get that some of you are trusting me with your hard-earned money to get the right advice to get smartphone buying advice and all that and i won't let you down bye
